evidenceLinks.title: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza denies using AI to write prize-winning story

developments.headline: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza denies using AI to write prize-winning story
developments.whyItMatters: Article in Atlantic claims The Blue Fighter was artificially generated, days after it won Caine prize for African writers The Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has denied using AI to write a prize-winning short story after an article in the Atlantic said software had flagged it as almost completely AI-generated. Kundizeza’s story The Blue Fighter was announced as the winner of the prestigious Caine prize for African writers on 6 October. Five days later, The Atlantic published an article by the author and journalist Vauhini Vara titled: “Yet Another Literary prize winner Seems to Be AI.”
